caption: The drawing depicts a single brown mortar with a rounded base and a slightly flared rim, sitting on a light blue circular pedestal. Inside the mortar, there is an off-white or light blue pestle, with its rounded end resting inside the vessel and its handle leaning out at an angle to the right. The inner surface of the mortar is colored a light orange-yellow, and the overall background of the drawing is a plain, beige tone with faint rectangular line borders suggesting a frame. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Mortar and Pestle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
